ns2:course.label: MFA Prof Practice Seminar
ns2:course.description: Examines current field practices and trends including curatorial practices, and interdisciplinary practices. Includes preparation of practical materials for career presentation and examination of resources. Approved for S/U grading only. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 6 hours. Prerequisite: Restricted to graduate dance students.
